what: W4-C diagnostician baseline: the LIVE build (catalog 2026.11.16, ./deploy mirror) served locally with the CDN headers by _harness/perf_load.mjs --serve deploy; cold, cache-disabled visits from a fresh Chrome profile; real clicks, no dev handle
chrome: Google Chrome (stable, /Applications) via playwright-core 1.64 channel chrome, headless

profiles.fast: GPU (ANGLE Metal, Apple M5), no throttle, 1366x768 DPR 1
profiles.weak: GPU, CDP CPU throttle 4x, network 20 Mbit down / 5 up / 40 ms RTT, 1366x768
profiles.nogpu: --disable-gpu (Chrome falls back to SwiftShader WebGL), CPU 4x, network as weak

notReproduced: Windows / ANGLE D3D11 HLSL translation and FXC compile times (this Mac is ANGLE Metal; shader numbers here are Metal and only scale-indicative)
an Intel UHD / Iris Xe or AMD integrated GPU and its shared-memory budget
Chrome GPU-process watchdog / TDR behaviour on Windows
Safari (WebKit not installed for Playwright; safaridriver needs Remote Automation enabled, owner consent) and Firefox (not installed)
caveats: the machine was shared with other agents' sim probes (load1 7-10 on 10 cores), so fps under CPU throttle is noisy (bench weak: medium 32 fps < high 45 fps is that noise, different fights)
the bench is _harness/web/render_bench built from the current source over the live catalog, the densest fight of a live RIFT 5v5 at t=600 s
the Practice draft is ~33 s of fixed clocks (pick 25 s + finalize 8 s): start-to-HUD includes it; loading-to-HUD is the load itself
shader per-program numbers are only in fast_practice (the inventory was added to the harness after the other runs)

calibrationCheck.source: src/render/calibration.ts calibVerdict on synthetic windows at 1366x768
calibrationCheck.rule: windows with < 30 intervals are dropped (CALIB_MIN_FRAMES); with none left the verdict is the High default, so the slowest devices keep High

intelUhdToday: No code reads WEBGL_debug_renderer_info, deviceMemory or hardwareConcurrency (grep src). An "ANGLE (Intel, Intel(R) UHD Graphics 620 Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)" string gets the stored default High; the first Home runs ~3 s at High (calibrate(), dynamic resolution off) and the verdict is Medium/Low only if it draws >= 30 frames at < 55 fps; a device that stalls under 10 fps stays High. Every tier loads the same full-size textures (bench low 801 MB vs high 861 MB of textures).
